## How    rivo   works

Always on. Always earning money in the background.

Step 01:

### Connect your bank securely

Link your checking account. Rivo analyzes your balance and learns spending patterns. Tell Rivo how much you always want in your account and it takes it from there.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6969482200a58c1c3a054ce1/696b10c5903e12dd4cc8e831_4b01c7ce8ed1a2e8712a08ebe860bdd5_work-1.svg)

Step 02:

### Earning starts automatically

Your cash automatically moves into U.S. government-backed assets and back before you need it. You are always in control. Transfer your money back to your bank anytime, for any reason, right in the app. It may take 1-3 business days for funds to show up in your external connected account.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6969482200a58c1c3a054ce1/6973413f27e180c9a42deae5_Group%20518.svg)

Step 03:

### Rivo plans around your bills

Rivo keeps enough cash in your bank account for your day-to-day spending. As bills and transfers approach, it moves money back into your account.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6969482200a58c1c3a054ce1/6973413ff3d94576e94cd3bd_Group%20519.svg)

Safety, Security & Control

## Your money is safe. And secure. And protected.

### Government backed securities

Your cash goes into the U.S. Treasury Bills, which are fully backed by the U.S. government. They are also protected by SIPC insurance up to $500,000

### Pay zero state and local taxes

Interest from US Treasuries is exempt from state and local income taxes [\*](https://www.rivofi.com/#tax-footnote), letting you keep more of your earnings, especially if you live in a high-tax area.

### Always accessible

Funds stay liquid. Rivo moves money back into checking before bills or transfers hit, so it’s there when you need it.

### Serious security

256-bit encryption, SOC 2 compliant infrastructure and bank-level security protocols protect every transaction.

### Total control

Pause automations, move money yourself, or disconnect anytime. Rivo runs in the background; you’re still in charge.

### Trusted team

Rivo was founded by a team of experienced AI and fintech builders who’ve spent decades building products for Fortune 100 in banking, automation and consumer trust.

Note: Rivo does not provide tax or investment advice. Talk to your advisor about your specific situation. Interest earned from Treasuries is generally exempt from state and local taxes, but any capital gains from sale of Treasuries prior to maturity is not exempt.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Do I have to switch banks to use Rivo?

No. Rivo works with your existing bank accounts. It connects securely through Plaid and automatically optimizes your cash without requiring you to switch banks, move direct deposits, or modify your bill pay setup.

### How is this different from a High Yield Savings account?

A High-Yield Savings Account (HYSA) is simple: you deposit cash in a bank, it's FDIC-insured, and you earn a variable interest rate that's still guaranteed by the bank. Rivo works differently. Instead of sitting in a bank account, your idle cash gets automatically invested in short-term U.S. Treasury Bills through Rivo's brokerage partner. This changes a few things. Protection: You get SIPC coverage (up to $500,000) instead of FDIC insurance. SIPC protects your assets if the brokerage fails, but it doesn't guarantee returns the way FDIC-backed accounts do. Returns: Because it's a market-based investment, your return can vary and isn't guaranteed like a bank rate. Automation: If you are on Rivo Autopilot, you don't have to manually move money around. Rivo automatically pulls funds back into your account before your bills are due, though transfers take 1-3 business days, so timing matters. Risk if you sell early: If you need to access your money before the T-Bill matures, selling early could reduce your return.

### Is this ‘Investing’? Am I taking a market risk?

Yes, Rivo invests your money in a brokerage-based product. Your cash is automatically invested in short-duration U.S. Treasury Bills. While these are backed by the federal government and remain independent of equity market swings, they carry standard fixed-income risks. Fluctuations in interest rates may affect value if assets are liquidated before they mature.

### Can I pause or stop Rivo’s automation?

Yes. You can pause, modify, or stop any automation at any time through the app settings.

### Can I set a minimum bank balance for my checking account?

Yes. You can set a minimum bank balance for your checking account, ensuring that Rivo never moves more than you're comfortable with.
